blurb: Erik (@sweriko) is a retro computing and game development enthusiast who creates demos and games for vintage hardware. He posted a chill surfing game for #vibejam and showcased a demo using a single 8-bit image with color cycling, designed for 30+ year old hardware. His content focuses on low-level graphics, retro programming, and demoscene-style projects. Follower count is not notable from available sources.
